title: Visiting merchants: the Travelling Merchant (dawn visits, rotating stock) and the Skeleton Merchant (underground, moon-phase stock)
player_outcome: On some mornings the Travelling Merchant walks into town ('The Travelling Merchant has arrived!') with a different random stock each visit, then leaves at dusk. Deep underground you may meet the Skeleton Merchant, whose wares change with the moon phase. Rally becomes obtainable from him.
design: TownNpcKind.Visitor. TownNpcParts.cs: VisitInfo { TypedSpec[] Requires (world facts, e.g. residents ≥ 2), string Mode (town|site), float DawnChance, float HourlyChance, TypedSpec[] Where (site mode), float ArriveHour, float LeaveHour, float WanderRadius, ShopPool[] Pools } with ShopPool { int Count; ShopEntry[] Entries }. Add TownNpcDef.Visit.

New TownSystem.Visitors.cs. At the dawn crossing, roll town visitors with Pcg32(seed, day, id). On arrival, place the visitor at a standable node 20–30 m outside a random housed resident's home, out of sight, and set r.VisitDay = day, r.Anchor = town centre (the mean of the homes); raise VisitorArrived. At LeaveHour, path away and remove once out of sight or more than 40 m away; raise VisitorLeft. Site visitors (Skeleton Merchant) roll HourlyChance while the player is in the Where layers, are placed with SiteFinder (P5-06), and leave when the player is more than 100 m away for 60 s or at the next dawn.

Stock: TownCommerce.Stock adds VisitorStock(npc) = the entries rolled from Pools with Pcg32(world seed, npc.VisitDay), whose conditions are evaluated normally. The stock is stable within a visit and changes the next visit.
Visitors never count as residents, never take homes and are excluded from happiness. TownRenderer and dialog work unchanged. TownAnnouncer shows the arrival/departure messages.
Persistence: ResidentModel gains Kind/VisitDay (optional). Commands: 'town visit <id>' forces an arrival, 'town leave <id>'. Probe town.<id> already covers presence.

Data (verify on the wiki): travelling_merchant with dawnChance ~0.225, requires residents ≥ 2, pools from Terraria's list limited to items that work (katana, lucky_horseshoe?, plus new ones such as pulse_bow, revolver, black_fairy_dust, gi, sitting_ducks_fishing_pole); skeleton_merchant with site mode, layer underground/cavern, entries gated by moon phase (wooden_yoyo, rally, magic_lantern at full moon (new light pet if pets exist, else defer), bone_arrow, lesser_healing_potion, bone_torch (new)).
